Version 0.2.1

Bug Fixes

  • caret_examples() failed with caret 7.1-0 for several reasons:

    • example("avNNet") is no longer in \dontrun{}. It relies on a conditionally assigned global that the globals package does not identify, so it is now skipped also when run.dontrun = FALSE.

    • Several examples, e.g. example("train"), now have all code in \dontrun{} inside @examplesIf, which gives “Error in srcrefs[[1L]] : subscript out of bounds” when called with run.dontrun = FALSE. These examples are now skipped.

    • example("yardstickSummary") attaches yardstick, which masks caret::precision() and other functions used by later examples. yardstick is now detached after each example.

Version 0.2.0

New Features

  • Add tests with registerDoFuture("%dofuture%").

  • Add tests with future.mirai.

  • No longer skipping some tests with future.callr.

Version 0.1.1

Significant Changes

  • The archived legacy package maptools is no longer suggested.

Version 0.1.0

  • First release.
